[LIMP.1.5] **A file's declarations resolve in that file's scope.** The compiler
must resolve every name a file's declarations use, a slot's type and a unit
literal in a constant's value among them,
against what that file declares, what its own imports bind ([LIMP.1.1]), and
what is in scope in every file ([LIMP.12.1], [LUNI.4.1.2]). An importer's
declarations, imports and aliases take no part, and neither does a library's own
import for its importer, unless the library re-exports the name ([LIMP.4.4.2]).

A file that reads a slot takes the type the declaring file gave it: a schema, a
unit, a dimension or an opaque type ([LUNI.4.1.5], [LOPQ.2.3]), whether or not
the reading file can name that type itself.

This is names alone. A library is validated under the importing program's
settings ([LDIA.2.10.9]).
